summary: Brandywine Realty Trust and Brandywine Operating Partnership, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting the extension of their revolving credit facility's maturity date by six months, from June 30, 2026 to December 30, 2026, under the existing Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The extension was exercised at the Borrowers' option for a fee of 0.0625% of the facility's principal. No other terms were modified. This is a routine financing maintenance event, not a special-situation catalyst. There are no stakeholder votes, advisor involvement, or structural changes to watch; the filing simply reflects a standard credit facility extension.
